title: iPhone: a failed thread read looks empty and the next ask sends no history
evidence: Root fix R29 (US-52 AC17): opening a saved conversation is one ChatThreadRead (ready | loading | failed) in ios/HealthRoadmap/Chat/ChatThreadRead.swift, changed only by its pure transition; ChatHistoryStore.open reads the file with a throwing read (stored) and moves the state, and its old opens counter is gone. ChatView draws the web's words for a failed read ("Couldn't open this conversation.", Try again, New chat) and keeps Send and the starters locked while a read is loading or failed; New chat and an erase send leave. Tests written, unrun (no simulator in this run): ChatThreadReadTests (transition table, unreadable file, a left read). Web twin: already built (N2, PR 1359; US-15 AC7a), no change.
